name: CompletedMatchGroundTruth
epl: @Name('CompletedMatchGroundTruth') select a as firstEvent, b as secondEvent from pattern [every a=Event(status='groundtruth') -> b=Event(status='groundtruth')]

name: CompletedMatchReconstructed
epl: @Name('CompletedMatchReconstructed') select a as firstEvent, b as secondEvent from pattern [every a=Event(status in ('observed','reconstructed')) -> b=Event(status in ('observed','reconstructed'))]

name: TimeoutMatchGroundTruth
epl: @Name('TimeoutMatchGroundTruth') select a as firstEvent, b as secondEvent from pattern [every a=Event(status='groundtruth') -> (b=Event(status='groundtruth') or timer:interval(5 sec))]

name: TimeoutMatchReconstructed
epl: @Name('TimeoutMatchReconstructed') select a as firstEvent, b as secondEvent from pattern [every a=Event(status in ('observed','reconstructed')) -> (b=Event(status in ('observed','reconstructed')) or timer:interval(5 sec))]
